tips.title: Select a metric configuration file
tips.body: Go to Settings > Configuration and choose ...\mcamxm.config <Metric> from the Current drop-down list, then click OK.

tips.title: Open a part file and assign a machine definition
tips.body: Open the tutorial part file Basic_3D_Machining_Part1_Start.MCX-5.

tips.title: Define stock for machining the part
tips.body: In the Toolpath Manager, select Stock setup and click Bounding box to create a stock boundary around the outer boundary of your geometry.

tips.title: Create a drill toolpath
tips.body: Right-click in the graphics window, choose Isometric (WCS), and then select Toolpaths > Drill.

tips.title: Select drill point position in the graphics screen
tips.body: Use the default option for Select drill point position in the graphics screen in the Drill Point Selection dialog box.

tips.title: Select a tool from the library
tips.body: Click Select library tool button and select the 10mm drill.

tips.title: Set linking parameters for the toolpath
tips.body: Select Linking Parameters from the Tree View pane and enter values to control the depth, top of stock location, and height to retract the tool.

tips.title: Turn off toolpath display after creating each operation
tips.body: Click the Toggle display on selected operations button to turn off the toolpath display for clarity in selecting geometry for subsequent steps.

tips.title: Use the 3D Advanced Toolpath Refinement feature for fine-tuning toolpath motion
tips.body: If the New 3D Advanced Toolpath Refinement Feature dialog box opens, select the option to eliminate this dialog box and make refinement available for use. Click OK to close the dialog box.

tips.title: Select drive surfaces using the Toolpath/Surface selection dialog box
tips.body: Follow the prompt to select drive surfaces as shown and press [Enter] or click the End Selection button to accept the selection.

tips.title: Limit chaining to entities parallel to the current construction plane
tips.body: Click the C-plane radio button in the Chaining dialog box to limit chaining to entities that are parallel to the current construction plane.

tips.title: Set stock to leave on drive for roughing operations
tips.body: Select Stock to leave on drive to a value of 1mm.

tips.title: Select the appropriate tool for roughing operations
tips.body: Select the 10mm bull endmill with a 2mm corner radius.

tips.title: Set cut parameters for roughing operations
tips.body: Set the parameters as indicated in the Cut Parameters section.

tips.title: Refine toolpath for better surface quality
tips.body: Move the slider for Surface quality to the Better setting in the Refine Toolpath dialog box.

tips.title: Turn off toolpath display after generating each operation
tips.body: Click the Toggle display on selected operations button to turn off the toolpath display for clarity in selecting geometry for subsequent steps.

tips.title: Save your part file after completing each operation
tips.body: Click OK to save the part file after generating and turning off the toolpath display for each operation.

tips.title: Use Surface High Speed toolpaths for finishing operations
tips.body: Select 'Toolpaths', then 'Surface High Speed' to perform finishing operations.

tips.title: Select drive surfaces for toolpaths
tips.body: Follow the prompt to select drive surfaces when creating toolpaths.

tips.title: Chain containment boundaries for toolpaths
tips.body: Use the Chaining dialog box to chain containment boundaries.

tips.title: Set tool containment for finishing operations
tips.body: Select 'Cut Parameters' and set the tool containment as shown.

tips.title: Refine toolpaths for better surface quality
tips.body: Click 'Refine Toolpath' and set the Surface quality to 'Best'.

tips.title: Select a suitable tool for finishing operations
tips.body: Choose the 6mm bull endmill with a 2mm corner radius.

tips.title: Set retract to absolute for deep slots
tips.body: In the Surface parameters tab, set Retract to 'Absolute' for proper clearance.

tips.title: Use Surface Finish Contour for finishing slots
tips.body: Select 'Toolpaths', then 'Surface Finish' and 'Contour' to finish a slot.

tips.title: Set total tolerance for finishing operations
tips.body: Click 'Total Tolerance' and set the Surface quality to 'Best'.

tips.title: Use Core Roughing for exterior surfaces
tips.body: Select 'Toolpaths', then 'Surface High Speed' and choose 'Roughing and Core Roughing'.

tips.title: Select a suitable tool for exterior roughing
tips.body: Choose the 10mm bull endmill with a 2mm corner radius.

tips.title: Set steep/shallow parameters for exterior roughing
tips.body: Select 'Steep/Shallow' and set the parameters as shown.

tips.title: Use Surface Finish Contour for exterior finishing
tips.body: Select 'Toolpaths', then 'Surface Finish' and 'Contour'.

tips.title: Select a suitable tool for exterior finishing
tips.body: Choose the 6mm flat endmill.

tips.title: Set parameters for surface finish contour toolpath
tips.body: Click Cut Depths, set parameters as shown, then click OK to generate the toolpath.

tips.title: Drill a hole from the Front Plane
tips.body: Select Front (WCS) plane, choose Drill toolpath type, select arc center, and click OK to generate the drill toolpath.

tips.title: Select a drill tool and set linking parameters
tips.body: Select the 6mm drill, go to Linking Parameters, and enter values as shown.

tips.title: Create lettering using a Surface Finish Project toolpath
tips.body: Choose Toolpaths, Surface Finish, Project, select drive surfaces, and click OK to generate the toolpath.

tips.title: Set parameters for the Surface Finish Project toolpath
tips.body: Select the 2mm ball endmill, set stock to leave as shown (negative value), and adjust gap settings.

tips.title: Create lettering using a Contour toolpath
tips.body: Select the Text Plane, choose Toolpaths, Contour, set chaining mode to window, and select Mastercam letters.

tips.title: Set parameters for the Contour toolpath
tips.body: Select the 1mm ball endmill, set Compensation type to Off, and uncheck lead in/out moves.

tips.title: Select a tool and set linking parameters for Contour toolpath
tips.body: Select the 1mm ball endmill, go to Linking Parameters, and enter values as shown.

tips.title: Set working coordinate system to WCS
tips.body: Click Copy to WCS button to set the resulting working coordinate system.

tips.title: Backplot all toolpaths
tips.body: Select all operations in Toolpath Manager and click 'Backplot selected operations' button.

tips.title: Verify all toolpaths
tips.body: Select all operations in Toolpath Manager and click 'Verify selected operations' button.

tips.title: Post all toolpaths to create an NC file
tips.body: Select all operations in Toolpath Manager and click 'Post selected operations' button.

tips.title: Assign a machine definition
tips.body: Open the part file and choose 'Machine Type, Mill, Default' in the Machine Definition dialog box.

tips.title: Define stock for machining
tips.body: In the Toolpath Manager, select 'Stock setup' and choose 'Bounding box' to create stock around the outer boundary of your geometry.

tips.title: Create a core roughing toolpath
tips.body: Choose 'Toolpaths, Surface High Speed' to create a core roughing operation.

tips.title: Create a leftover toolpath
tips.body: After creating the core roughing operation, create a leftover operation to remove any remaining material.

tips.title: Select drive surfaces using the Select button
tips.body: Click the Select button in the Containment area of the Toolpath/Surface selection dialog box.

tips.title: Set parameters for roughing operations
tips.body: Select Cut Parameters and Steep / Shallow from the Tree View pane, then set the parameters as indicated.

tips.title: Generate core roughing toolpath and toggle display
tips.body: Click OK to generate the core roughing toolpath, then click the Toggle display on selected operations button.

tips.title: Create a Surface Finish Leftover toolpath
tips.body: Choose Toolpaths, Surface Finish, Leftover and select the last surface.

tips.title: Set parameters for Surface Finish Leftover toolpath
tips.body: Select the 4mm bull endmill, set stock to leave on drive to 1.0, and click OK.

tips.title: Generate Surface Finish Leftover toolpath and toggle display
tips.body: Click OK to generate the surface finish leftover toolpath, then turn off the toolpath display for the operation.

tips.title: Create a Surface Finish Blend toolpath
tips.body: Choose Toolpaths, Surface Finish, Blend and select the last surface.

tips.title: Set parameters for Surface Finish Blend toolpath
tips.body: Select the 4mm bull endmill, set stock to leave on drive to 0.25, and click OK.

tips.title: Generate Surface Finish Blend toolpath and toggle display
tips.body: Click OK to generate the surface finish blend toolpath, then turn off the toolpath display for the operation.

tips.title: Create a Surface Finish Parallel Steep toolpath
tips.body: Choose Toolpaths, Surface Finish, Parallel Steep and select the last surface.

tips.title: Set parameters for Surface Finish Parallel Steep toolpath
tips.body: Select the 2mm ball endmill, set stock to leave on drive to 0.25, and click OK.

tips.title: Generate Surface Finish Parallel Steep toolpath and toggle display
tips.body: Click OK to generate the parallel steep toolpath, then turn off the toolpath display for the operation.

tips.title: Copy and modify an operation
tips.body: Right-click the Surface Finish Parallel Steep operation, select Copy after, and modify parameters as needed.

tips.title: Turn off toolpath display for operations
tips.body: This helps in focusing on other aspects of the operation without being distracted by the visual representation.

tips.title: Save your part file after each operation
tips.body: Regularly saving ensures that you don't lose progress in case of a system crash or power outage.

tips.title: Use the Chaining dialog box for complex toolpaths
tips.body: The Chaining dialog box allows for detailed control over how toolpaths are generated, including direction and selection of entities.

tips.title: Select the correct tool for finishing operations
tips.body: For finishing, use a smaller tool with a finer corner radius to achieve better surface finish quality.

tips.title: Set appropriate parameters for swept 3D toolpaths
tips.body: Parameters such as depth of cut, stepover, and feed should be adjusted based on the material and desired finish.

tips.title: Use the Flowline toolpath for surface finishing
tips.body: The Flowline toolpath is ideal for achieving a smooth finish on surfaces, especially when using smaller tools.

tips.title: Adjust flowline parameters for optimal results
tips.body: Parameters such as total tolerance and finish flowline settings should be fine-tuned based on the material and desired finish.

tips.title: Backplot and verify toolpaths before actual machining
tips.body: This ensures that the toolpaths are collision-free and will produce the desired results without any issues during actual machining.

tips.title: Select all operations in Toolpath Manager
tips.body: Click the Select all operations button.

tips.title: Post selected operations
tips.body: Click the Post selected operations button.

tips.title: Set post processing options
tips.body: Set the post processing options as shown.

tips.title: Save NC file
tips.body: Click Save to save the NC file in the default location with the recommended file name.

tips.title: Review and edit NC code
tips.body: Scroll through the NC code to verify that each line of code meets your expectations. Edit and save as necessary.

tips.title: Send NC file to machine control
tips.body: Send the NC code to your machine control according to your machine and control manufacturer’s documentation.
